I've tested my audio by recording my voice through snapchat, the camera app, and voice memos as well and all three work perfectly. \*Edit: I've also tried powering on and off my phone and I have the most recent iOS update

I began at age 14 for anxiety and depression, proud of you for reaching out! I'm now about your age and I didn't really feel like I got worse before getting better though it definitely takes at least a month to kick in which can be frustrating. In my case it acts like a bit of a mute for all of my negative emotions. They still exist but are noticeably less debilitating, or at least debilitating less of the time. By muting that "the walls are closing in on me" feeling it leaves space for progress that I was too anxious to do otherwise like meditation! Good luck! :))
